technical-summary: The helper printed its live-policy calibration waiting line with a literal backslash-n, so the RHP16_CALIBRATION_JSON record was emitted mid-line and the launcher's anchored grep never saw it; calibration kept serving prompts after the record was complete. Report lines now end in a real newline (calibration_report_line) with a framing test.
user-summary-candidate: Calibrating the live expert placement now stops when it has finished instead of running until someone stops it.
